_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Estimate EU duty on a low-value consignment
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Estimate EU duty on a low-value consignment...

description:
Best for: the EUR 3 per item EU customs duty on a consignment up to EUR 150 under IOSS or post, 2026-07-01 to 2028-07-01 (Reg. (EU) 2026/382, 2026/1022). Covers only channel "ioss" or "postal" (courier outside IOSS is not covered; if asked about a courier like DHL without IOSS, call with "ioss" and state courier outside IOSS is not covered).
Returns: item count as given (1 tariff item = EUR 3 per order line, regardless of qty units) and with identical lines merged, duty_eur, legal_basis and assumptions. Over EUR 150 or outside the window, duty_eur is null.
Input tips: lines (1-200) of {description, origin (2 letters), qty, unit_value_eur, optional hs_code} and channel ("ioss" or "postal"), optional consignment_value_eur and date. Never send customer fields.

channel.description: How the goods enter the EU: "ioss" (VAT-exempt under the Import One-Stop Shop) or "postal" (a postal consignment). The EUR 3 rule covers only "ioss" or "postal" entries (courier shipments outside IOSS are not covered; if the user says courier such as DHL without specifying IOSS, pass "ioss" to show the EUR 3 IOSS figure and state clearly that a courier entry outside IOSS is not covered and needs IOSS or postal).

consignment_value_eur.description: Intrinsic value of the whole consignment in euros, if different from the sum of the lines

lines.description: Lines (1 to 200), each {description, origin (2 letters), qty (integer), unit_value_eur (euros), optional hs_code}, such as [{"description":"mug","origin":"CN","qty":2,"unit_value_eur":12}].

description.description: What the goods are, such as "cotton t-shirt"

hs_code.description: 6, 8 or 10 digit tariff code, dots allowed, if known (a candidate, not binding)

origin.description: 2-letter country the goods were made in, such as CN

unit_value_eur.description: Price of one unit in euros

name: eu_duty_estimate

duty_eur.description: Total EUR 3 duty for the consignment (items * EUR 3, not qty * EUR 3), or null when exempt_reason is set.

duty_if_identical_lines_grouped_eur.description: Duty with identical lines merged, or null when exempt_reason is set.

items.description: Tariff items (order lines) as given: one EUR 3 duty per order line, regardless of qty units on that line.

items_if_identical_lines_grouped.description: Items if lines with the same code, description and origin are merged.

note.description: Plain-language breakdown of items vs units, or reason when exempt_reason is set.

value_eur.description: Consignment value used for the EUR 150 test.

total_duty_eur.description: Total EUR 3 duty in euros, as lines are given. 0 when the consignment is exempt.

title: Estimate EU duty on a low-value consignment
